title: Rainbow Realm
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1 is Rainbow Realm title-card artwork. Change ONLY framing of the central title-and-basket group. Uniformly scale the complete "Rainbow Realm" lettering and the full fruit basket, fruit and lining to 75% of their current size and center the reduced group in the same true 2:1 landscape canvas. Seamlessly continue the existing orchard, meadow, sky and rainbow in the extra space. Preserve exact title spelling, bold gold/ivory letters with purple shadows, all fruit varieties and their shapes, basket material, warm sunlight, palette and premium illustration style. The topmost title letter must be at least 15% below the top edge and the full basket at least 15% above the bottom edge, every essential element inside central 80% width / 70% height. Background trees/rainbow may reach canvas edges. No added text, people, props, UI, logos or watermark. One opaque image only.
initialGenerationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: one polished original Rainbow Realm key-art image, preserving its bright classic-fruit orchard identity.
Scene/backdrop: a magical sunlit orchard with rounded emerald-green hills, glossy rounded fruit-tree canopies at the sides, warm golden sky and one rich multicoloured rainbow arch in the background. Painterly, spacious and inviting.
Subject: a beautiful small wicker harvest basket with a red-and-white gingham lining, containing cherries, an orange, a lemon, a purple grape bunch, a glossy apple and a prominent red watermelon wedge with green rind. Fruit looks luscious, crisp and jewel-bright, not plastic. Basket is the clear lower-middle focal object, with restrained leaf details; no characters.
Style/medium: sophisticated premium cartoon game illustration, softly painted textures, controlled dimensional highlights, strong clean silhouette. Coral reds, green orchard, purple grapes, sunshine gold and cyan rainbow accents. A cohesive high-quality game-cover finish, no photorealism.
Composition/framing: TRUE wide 2:1 landscape canvas. Title centered above a compact centered basket, background trees frame the sides; this is a balanced triangular composition. Keep complete title and entire fruit basket comfortably inside the central 75% width and 65% height, with generous quiet margins beyond; all essential artwork must fit central 80% width / 70% height. The rainbow and trees may extend into the background margins. No title-fruit overlap. Readable at 256x128.
Text (verbatim): "Rainbow Realm". Exactly once, on two large balanced lines, substantial rounded gold/ivory display lettering with a subtle deep-purple shadow for excellent contrast against the warm sky. Both words prominent and crisp.
Constraints: no leprechauns, pots of gold, coins, added cultural symbols, extra wording, slogans, payouts, reels, fake game interface, buttons, logos, other brands or watermark. Opaque background. One image only.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected master and 768x384 WebP. Exact title, orchard rainbow, rounded green hills and gingham-lined wicker basket with existing fruit identities including watermelon. No added character, cultural motif, slogan or interface.
visualCheck.thumbnail: Inspected at 256x128. Both title words remain clear with purple-shadow contrast and fruit basket remains recognizable.
visualCheck.crop: Framing-only v2 keeps complete title and basket within central 80% width / 70% height. Background orchard/rainbow fills outer margins.
visualCheck.compression: WebP quality 84; 106,336 bytes, under 120 KB ideal target.
visualCheck.revision: Original master retained outside src; v2 selects the crop-safety refinement. Artwork files only.
